# Design of purlins 

## Purlin capacity from Lysaght

![Lysaght capacity, double-lapped span](images/Z20019_cap.png){width="90%" #fig-lysaght-capacity}

## Purlin loads

```{julia}
des_purlin=get_purlin_wind_load(bldg_yy; # bldg_yy is from previous step
    wind_dir_meteo=:E,
    isUplift=true,
    s_purlin=1.2m, # spacing of purlins
    L_purlin=5.5m, # supported span of purlins
    loaded_surfaces=[:Roof, :Internal],
    kv=1.0, # assumed 1.0
    );
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
println(des_purlin.calc_details)
```

## Design of purlins, overhang
 
```{julia}
loadwidth_purlin=1.2m 
span_overhang = 1.4m
kl_rc1_overhang = fKl(a=bldg_yy.a_roofs, loadwidth=loadwidth_purlin, span=span_overhang, symbol=:RC1)

fw = [fwind_purlin(bldg_yy;
          wind_dir=:E,
          isUplift=true,
          isUpwind=true,
          bw=loadwidth_purlin,
          lw=span_overhang,
          x_from_windward_edge=0m,
          loaded_surfaces=[:Roof, :Internal],  
          kl=kl,
          kv=1.0).load |> kN_per_m |> f2 for kl in [kl_rc1_overhang]]
```


From @fig-lysaght-capacity, with 1 bridging, maximum capacity is 4.88kN/m > load, pass.

## Space gass design for overhanging purlin

![Purlin design ratio < 1.0, pass according to AS4600.](images/design_ratio_purlinZ20019.png)

purlin summary:

- Use Z20019 double-lapped-span @ 1200mm, 1 bridging
